Name: MuseDeck
Author: memetcircus
Description: Human-in-the-Loop Mission Control & Telemetry Console for Meta Muse Code CLI & Meta Model API (SAM 3.1 & Muse Spark). Built for Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.

Actions.Name: Agent Status
Actions.Tooltip: Dynamic visual status badge for Meta Muse Code (IDLE, PLANNING, WAITING_APPROVAL, EXECUTING, ERROR)

Actions.Name: Voice Input (⌥+V)
Actions.Tooltip: Physical toggle for Meta Muse Code CLI native voice input (Option+V).

Actions.Name: Diff Summary
Actions.Tooltip: Displays git diff metrics (+lines / -lines). Tap to open diff inspector.

Actions.Name: Approve (HITL)
Actions.Tooltip: Physical Human-in-the-Loop Approval key. Press to unpause agent when waiting for review.

Actions.Name: Reject (HITL)
Actions.Tooltip: Physical Human-in-the-Loop Rejection key. Press to reject diff and request revision.

Actions.Name: Screenshot
Actions.Tooltip: Interactive screen capture: snip UI region and insert image path directly into terminal.

Actions.Name: Image to Code
Actions.Tooltip: Dispatches SAM 3.1 segmented UI to Meta Muse Spark to synthesize React & Tailwind CSS code.

Actions.Name: Run Muse
Actions.Tooltip: Start or execute the queued Meta Muse Code task.

Actions.Name: Halt / Stop
Actions.Tooltip: Emergency stop. Immediately halts child processes and cancels running agent workflows.

Actions.Name: Reset Agent
Actions.Tooltip: Clears agent buffers and resets state back to IDLE.

Actions.Name: Prompt Task
Actions.Tooltip: Sends a preset coding task to Muse Code.

Actions.Name: Write Tests
Actions.Tooltip: Triggers Muse Code to generate comprehensive test coverage in parallel worktrees.

Actions.Name: Fix Bug
Actions.Tooltip: Passes the latest runtime error or exception to Muse Code for automated patch generation.

Actions.Name: Commit & PR
Actions.Tooltip: Stages verified changes, generates semantic commit message, and prepares pull request.

Actions.Name: Web Console
Actions.Tooltip: Opens the MuseDeck Web Mission Control dashboard in browser.

Actions.Name: Page 2 →
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate to Page 2 (Multimodal Video & Deep Workflows).

Actions.Name: Record to Fix
Actions.Tooltip: Record screen + voiceover MP4, upload via Meta Responses & Files API, and diagnose bug in Muse Code.

Actions.Name: Video to Code
Actions.Tooltip: Convert multimodal screen recording into React & Tailwind component with Meta Files API.

Actions.Name: Upload File
Actions.Tooltip: Upload media assets to Meta Files API, retrieve file_id, and attach to current coding context.

Actions.Name: Audio Transcription
Actions.Tooltip: Transcribe developer speech prompt into formal technical specifications.

Actions.Name: Re-Inspect Diff
Actions.Tooltip: Re-inspect git diff and verify code quality against spec in web inspector.

Actions.Name: Phone Recording
Actions.Tooltip: Inspect mobile viewport recording and synthesize mobile UI fixes.

Actions.Name: Style Transfer
Actions.Tooltip: Perform complete UI style transfer and theme polish on active components.

Actions.Name: Workspace Tree
Actions.Tooltip: Analyze full workspace architecture, dependencies, and git worktrees.

Actions.Name: Terminal Log
Actions.Tooltip: Bring active Muse Terminal session to front to view live streaming logs.

Actions.Name: Rewind Work
Actions.Tooltip: Inspect git status and discard uncommitted test changes.

Actions.Name: Clear Media
Actions.Tooltip: Purge temporary recording cache in /tmp/musedeck.

Actions.Name: API Status
Actions.Tooltip: Check Meta API health and telemetry latency metrics.

Actions.Name: Spark Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Start creative architectural design conversation with Meta Muse Spark.

Actions.Name: Open Work
Actions.Tooltip: Open workspace folder in Finder or VS Code.

Actions.Name: ← Page 1
Actions.Tooltip: Navigate back to Page 1.
